<analysis>
Let me chronologically analyze this conversation about building a cat-catching-fish web game.

**Initial Goal (user message 1):**
The user provided a confirmed build brief in Chinese for "小猫接鱼" (Kitty Fish Catch): a cute cat game where you move a cat to catch falling fish, dodge trash, 60-second rounds, warm/lively art style, relaxing music, playable on mobile and desktop. Selected option: classic fish-catching challenge mode. Settings: Web platform, React engine, Cartoon visual style, 2D, Arcade genre, Touch + Keyboard/mouse inputs, Landscape orientation, resource library optional. Scope: one cat, three fish types, two trash types, one 60s level, scoring + result screen, warm lively BGM and SFX. Document/user-visible/agent response language all Chinese. The user instructed autonomous planning/execution, save UI/scene references before bulk production using structured uiReference + ui-board-plan, continue through implementation and runtime checks, don't precommit image count, don't stop at visual-direction handoff, preserve explicit choices, ask when material choice/authorization missing, don't claim unperformed checks.

BGS tool paths given under `.beegame/tmp/goal-tools-S66Tsk/`: measure.mjs, handoff.mjs, assets.mjs, check-content.mjs, consumer.mjs, bind-content.mjs, media.mjs, resources.mjs, preview.mjs. AI image bridge configured-but-unverified; use assets.mjs cost before generate; stable requestId for recovery; bridges expire at turn end.

**My approach:**
1. Listed empty project dir, read all tool helps.
2. Loaded game-plan-execution skill.
3. Tested bun network install — works (react 19.3.0 installed in tmp test).
4. Checked image cost: low 1024 = 3 credits, 1536x1024 = 4 credits; available cloudflare gpt-image-2.5-flare.
5. Wrote 8 docs in docs/: GDD.md, TECHNICAL_DESIGN.md, ART_DIRECTION.md, AUDIO_DESIGN.md, UI_UX_SPEC.md, LEVEL_SCENE_DESIGN.md, BALANCE_DESIGN.md, ASSET_PLAN.md.
6. Generated 4 images via assets.mjs:
   - ui-board: requestId kittyfish-uiboard-v1, success, 4 credits, assets/visual/ui-board.png (sha256 5f856c...)
   - scene-board: requestId kittyfish-sceneboard-v1, success, 4 credits, assets/visual/scene-board.png (5ac825...)
   - bg: requestId kittyfish-bg-v1 first attempt 502 unknown; replay same ID got 409 (cannot replay unknown); per recovery I created kittyfish-bg-v2 which succeeded, 4 credits → assets/source/bg-kitchen.png (0923fe...)
   - sprites: kittyfish-sprites-v1 → 503 then 502 unknown; retried as kittyfish-sprites-v2 in background → success, 3 credits, assets/source/sprites-raw.png (3b0ab8...)
7. Wrote package.json, vite.config.js, index.html, initial content JSON (later rewritten).
8. Analyzed sprite sheet alpha with custom Python (components.py) — 6 big components found, union bounds per cell. Cropped/resized with media.mjs images operation, packed atlas via media.mjs atlas (had to output to assets/runtime/ not public/assets/runtime/). Created assets/runtime/sprites.png (830x656) + sprites.atlas.json with 6 named frames. Copied bg to assets/runtime/bg.png.
9. Generated audio: recipe JSON, first failed because sine sources must be type "oscillator" (not "sine"); fixed with sed → 12 WAVs rendered to assets/runtime/audio/ (bgm + 11 sfx).
10. Registered resources — multiple schema failures fixed iteratively: selection_reason must be array; source only accepts web form (removed source for agent-authored); requirements need acquisition_profile with dimensions (canonical "2D"), asset_kinds (canonical: image, sprite-atlas, audio-clip), styles; resource dimension "2D". Registration succeeded → assets/asset-manifest.json with 14 resources.
11. Rewrote content/ to v2 schema: scene level1.json (beegame-content.v1, game-object-v2), 5 UI docs. Errors fixed: top-level "name" unrecognized (removed); index needs schema beegame-content-package.v2 with id/dimension/entryScene/sceneModel/documentRevision/assetManifestRevision/files/documents loadPhase. Derived revisions via --package-metadata. Scene image needed canvas ancestor + rect-transform + canvas-renderer (added screen-canvas node with rect-transform + canvas, background parented to it). UI root.data needs orientation Landscape, referenceResolution [1280,720], targetViewports as array of [w,h] pairs, minimumControlSize [48,48]. Smaller viewports (667x375, 844x390) caused out-of-viewport errors since layout is fixed 1280 logical and runtime letterboxes — restricted targetViewports to [[1280,720],[1920,1080]], --design-layouts then valid. Final documentRevision starts 9ae049f46b79, assetManifestRevision 8fc32bba..., --current valid:true.
12. Started app code: src/game/config.js (tuned CATCH lineY 560 basketHalfWidth 44, CAT width 153 height 190, ITEM_DRAW_H; also updated scene zones config to match), src/game/input.js, src/game/content-client.js, src/game/audio.js, and just wrote src/game/engine.js (the most recent action).

The engine.js was the last file written. Still pending: src/main.jsx, src/App.jsx, components (GameCanvas, Hud, Menu, PauseDialog, ResultScreen, Countdown, OrientationGate), styles.css; need a Vite plugin or public copy strategy for assets/runtime + content + asset-manifest (currently assets/ is NOT under public/, so build won't include it — content-client fetches ./content/... and ./assets/asset-manifest.json; need to make Vite copy these, e.g. put them in public/ or configure vite publicDir/copy). Then bun install, vite build, measure.mjs with consumption probes, preview.mjs --run interaction test at 1280x720 and portrait orientation gate.

Key security/authorization constraints to preserve: AI image billing quotes read-only; unknown receipt 502/409 rules (don't change requestId merely to retry; report failure; my v2 IDs were a recovery action, and earlier unknown requests (kittyfish-bg-v1, kittyfish-sprites-v1) remain UNKNOWN — not settled, not proven billed or delivered); bridges expire turn end; don't claim unperformed checks/game acceptance; errors are not empty search results.

Let me note exact frame rects, audio ids, config values for continuity.

Atlas frames (assets/runtime/sprites.atlas.json):
- cat-basket: x1 y1 w332 h412
- fish-yellow: x335 y1 w225 h154
- fish-blue: x562 y1 w267 h194
- fish-gold: x1 y415 w231 h204
- trash-can: x234 y415 w163 h194
- trash-boot: x399 y415 w192 h240

Engine details: fixed step 1/120, rAF render, DPR capped 2, canvas internal 1280*dpr, logical 1280x720, phases idle/playing/paused/finished, zones read from content, audio manager hooks onFinish/onHud, debugFastForward test hook. Cat drawn bottom 706. Items catch when y in [catchY, catchY+40] and |x-cat.x| <= basketHalfW + item width*0.32.

Audio recipe output ids: audio/bgm-kitchen etc (12 total). Manifest resources: img/background-kitchen, atlas/sprites, audio/bgm-kitchen, 11 sfx.

Requirements: req/background-kitchen, req/sprite-atlas, req/audio-bgm, req/audio-sfx.
</analysis>

<summary>
1. Primary Request and Intent:
   The user (via a confirmed BGS build brief, all in Chinese; agent must respond in Chinese) requested autonomous development of a complete playable web game "小猫接鱼" (Kitty Fish Catch):
   - Core idea: 移动小猫接住掉下来的鱼，躲开混在里面的垃圾，一局一分钟计分 (move cat at bottom to catch falling fish, dodge mixed-in trash, 60-second round, high score).
   - Selected mode "经典接鱼挑战模式": cat moves left/right at screen bottom; catching fish scores; gold fish worth more; trash deducts points AND briefly slows the cat; fall speed/density increase over time; 60s result settlement; missing normal fish does NOT end game but missing many fish reduces a bonus.
   - Confirmed scope: 1 cat, 3 fish types (小黄鱼+10, 蓝大鱼+20, 金鱼+50), 2 trash types (易拉罐−10 slow 1.5s, 烂靴子−20 slow 2.5s), one 60s level, basic scoring + result screen, warm/lively BGM and SFX.
   - Settings: platform Web; engine React; visual Cartoon; 2D; genre Arcade; inputs Touch + Keyboard/mouse; orientation Landscape; resource library usage optional. document/game/agent language all zh.
   - Explicit process instructions: plan & execute autonomously (don't wait for BGS milestones); for a visual game SAVE and INSPECT complete-screen UI layout references and distinct scene/prop references BEFORE bulk production, using structured uiReference inputs and ui-board-plan so project screen proportions and actual screen/state list determine the equal-cell grid; continue through implementation AND actual runtime checks in this same assignment; do NOT precommit an image count; do NOT stop at visual-direction handoff or request second production authorization; preserve explicit user choices; ask the user when a material choice or authorization is missing; do NOT claim unperformed checks or game acceptance.

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - Vite 5 + React 19 (JS, not TS), static build to dist/, base './'.
   - Single full-screen Canvas 2D (1280×720 logical, DPR-capped internal buffer) + React DOM overlays for menu/HUD/pause/result.
   - Fixed-timestep accumulator (1/120s) + rAF rendering; entity system (cat, items, floaters, particles).
   - Logical 1280×720 resolution uniformly scaled/letterboxed via CSS transform on #logical-root; portrait orientation gate.
   - Editable content as BGS v2 content package: content/index.json (beegame-content-package.v2) + scene (game-object-v2, beegame-content.v1) + ui-screen/ui-hud docs; validated with check-content.mjs (--current, --package-metadata, --design-layouts, --scene-layouts, --format).
   - Asset Manifest v9 via resources.mjs register (requirements + resources + acquisition_profile + projectTarget); runtime assets under assets/runtime.
   - AI image generation via assets.mjs (cloudflare gpt-image-2.5-flare): structured uiReference board (2×2 equal cells auto-computed), free-form scene board, opaque background, transparent sprite sheet; cost quotes (low: 3 credits 1024², 4 credits 1536×1024); stable requestId recovery semantics.
   - Sprite production: Python stdlib PNG decode + connected-component alpha-bounds analysis → media.mjs images (crop/resize lanczos3 +2px padding) → media.mjs atlas (linear filtering, edge-copy padding) → register.
   - Programmatic audio: resources.mjs beegame-programmatic-audio-v1 recipe → 44.1kHz stereo PCM16 WAV (oscillator triangle/sine/square + noise brown/white).
   - HTMLAudio BGM (loop) + 8-voice SFX pool; autoplay unlock on user gesture; mute persisted localStorage.
   - Pending verification tools: measure.mjs --request --artifact dist (with --consumption-json uiProbes/sceneProbes/audioProbes, coordinateRoot:"#logical-root"), preview.mjs --run test.mjs with snapshots at viewports.

3. Files and Code Sections:
   All under project root: /Users/nswell/Documents/PhantomsXR/Projects/InternalProjects/Others/BeeGameStudio/Projects/users/30fb0202-1f77-414f-82da-f92936e7bba3/kitty-fish-catch--0e70651e10cd

   - docs/GDD.md, TECHNICAL_DESIGN.md, ART_DIRECTION.md, AUDIO_DESIGN.md, UI_UX_SPEC.md, LEVEL_SCENE_DESIGN.md, BALANCE_DESIGN.md, ASSET_PLAN.md
     - Eight-domain design docs (Chinese). Define: scoring/combo (every 5-combo +5), catch-rate bonus tiers (≥.90 +150 百发百中; ≥.75 +80; ≥.60 +30), difficulty curves (spawn interval lerp 1.05→0.52s, fall speed 200→340, trash chance 0 until 8s then lerp .18→.30, gold weights), palette (#FFF3DF/#FF7A6B/#5B3A29 etc), 12 audio cues, zones (catchLine, basketHalfWidth), file structure.

   - package.json: scripts dev/build/preview (vite); deps react ^19.3.0 react-dom; devDeps @vitejs/plugin-react ^4.3.4 vite ^5.4.11. NOTE: bun install has NOT yet been run in the project.
   - vite.config.js: react plugin, base './', outDir dist, assetsDir assets. (A mechanism to copy content/, assets/runtime, assets/asset-manifest.json into dist is STILL NEEDED — they are not under public/.)
   - index.html: zh-CN, viewport no-scale, #root, /src/main.jsx.

   - content/index.json (FINAL, valid):
     schema beegame-content-package.v2, id kitty-fish-catch-v1, dimension "2d", entryScene scene-level1, sceneModel game-object-v2, documentRevision "9ae049f46b79..." (must be re-derived if docs change), assetManifestRevision "8fc32bba00bbd3f0b318eb560c2085edc94f69ceba63fce2dcc94a8c66d6bbcc", files [scenes/level1.json, ui/menu,hud,countdown,pause,result.json], all documents loadPhase "startup".

   - content/scenes/level1.json: nodes: camera-main (camera orthographic, orthographicSize 360, viewport 1280×720, framing letterbox); screen-canvas (rect-transform anchors 0–1 + canvas screen-space-overlay); background (parentId screen-canvas; rect-transform + canvas-renderer + image assetRef "img/background-kitchen", data sizing cover rect 0,0,1280,720); gameplay-zones node with behavior kind "kittyfish-zones" config FINAL values:
     spawnBand {xMin96,xMax1184,y:-60}; catchLine {y:560,halfHeight:26}; basketHalfWidth 44; catBand {xMin120,xMax1160}; catHome {x:640,y:620}; missLine {y:730}; catDrawnSize {width153,height190}.

   - content/ui/menu.json, hud.json, countdown.json, pause.json, result.json: v2 ui docs. Each root role screen-root/hud-root with data {orientation:"Landscape", referenceResolution:[1280,720], targetViewports:[[1280,720],[1920,1080]], minimumControlSize:[48,48]}. Nodes use layout {position:[x,y],size:[w,h]}, role (text/button/shape/container/sprite), style.variant, actions {"click":"game.start|game.pause|game.resume|game.restart|game.home|ui.toggle-mute"}, bindings {"text":"score|time|comboLabel|highscore|bonusLabel"}, data.visibleWhen (custom strings e.g. "combo>=2", "time<=10", "isRecord", "bonus>0", "slowdown>0"). menu cat-hero sprite assetRef atlas/sprites data.frame "cat-basket". result stat-grid cells icons fish-yellow/fish-gold/miss/trash-can bindings caught/golden/missed/trashHits.

   - assets/visual/ui-board.png and scene-board.png: AI reference boards (reference only, not runtime). bg source assets/source/bg-kitchen.png; copied to assets/runtime/bg.png (1536×1024). sprites source assets/source/sprites-raw.png (1024² transparent) + cropped assets/source/frames/{cat-basket,fish-yellow,fish-blue,fish-gold,trash-can,trash-boot}.png.
   - assets/runtime/sprites.png (830×656) + sprites.atlas.json frames: cat-basket {x1,y1,w332,h412}; fish-yellow {335,1,225,154}; fish-blue {562,1,267,194}; fish-gold {1,415,231,204}; trash-can {234,415,163,194}; trash-boot {399,415,192,240}.
   - assets/runtime/audio/: bgm-kitchen.wav (16000ms loop) + sfx-catch, sfx-golden, sfx-trash, sfx-miss, sfx-dodge, sfx-count, sfx-go, sfx-end, sfx-button, sfx-pause, sfx-record.
   - assets/asset-manifest.json + assets/manifest/ (auto-generated by register; 14 resources, requirements req/background-kitchen, req/sprite-atlas, req/audio-bgm, req/audio-sfx).

   - src/game/config.js (created, then edited): VIEW 1280×720; DURATION 60; CAT {maxSpeed620,accel2600,friction3000,pointerFollow14,minX120,maxX1160,startX640,slowFactor.55,slowCanMs1500,slowBootMs2500,width153,height190}; CATCH fallback {lineY560,halfHeight26,basketHalfWidth44}; SPAWN; spawnInterval(t)/fallSpeed(t)/trashChance(t)/fishKind(t)/trashKind(t); FISH_SCORE, TRASH_SCORE, COMBO_BONUS_EVERY=5/COMBO_BONUS=5, bonusForCatchRate; ITEM_DRAW_H {fish-yellow:76,fish-blue:92,fish-gold:90,trash-can:96,trash-boot:104}; IS_TRASH.

   - src/game/input.js: InputController(target,toLogicalX); tracks keys left/right (arrows + A/D), pointer (mouse follows without press, touch requires press); axis(), pointerActive/pointerX; dispose().
   - src/game/content-client.js: loadGameContent(base='.') fetches content/index.json → all docs; fetches assets/asset-manifest.json then each modules.resources JSON to map resource id→root_path; loads bg image and atlas image/json; builds audio id map (12 ids); extractZones finds kittyfish-zones config; returns {index,docs,manifest,bgImage,atlasImage,atlasJson,audio,zones}.
   - src/game/audio.js: AudioManager(urls); mute localStorage key 'kitty-fish-muted-v1'; unlock/startBgm/stopBgm/setBgmVolume/playSfx(id,{rate})/setMuted; 8-voice rotating pool, bgm volume .5.
   - src/game/engine.js (MOST RECENT FILE WRITTEN): class GameEngine. Constructor sets canvas 1280*dpr, reads frames/zones, computes item sizes from atlas ratios, catDraw from cat-basket ratio with height CAT.height; _resetWorld stats {score,caught,golden,missed,trashHits,fishSpawned,combo}; start/pause/resume/destroy; _loop fixed-step; _spawn (trash roll then fishKind/trashKind); _updateCat (keyboard accel/friction, pointer exponential follow, slow factor, x clamp, mood/squish); _updateItems catch condition `it.y>=catchY && <=catchY+40 && |x-cat.x|<=basketHalfW+itemW*.32`, pop arc animation; _resolveCatch (score, combo bonus, mood, slowUntil via performance.now, shake, floaters, particles, SFX); _resolveMiss (fish: missed++, combo reset, sad, sfx-miss; trash: sfx-dodge); _finish computes catch-rate bonus, onFinish callback; getHud returns {score,time,combo,comboLabel,slowdown,playing}; getResult; debugFastForward(seconds) test hook; _render draws cover bg (or gradient fallback), items with gold glow/rotation/sway, cat (tilt/squish/dizzy saturate filter, bottom=706), star particles, floating score text. NOTE: slowdown HUD ratio uses cat.slowDur; verify initialization edge cases during runtime test.

4. Errors and fixes:
   - Image bg generation requestId kittyfish-bg-v1: HTTP 502 outcome "unknown" then same-requestId replay returned HTTP 409 ("Replaying an unknown/rejected receipt does not resubmit upstream"). Fix/action: resubmitted as NEW requestId kittyfish-bg-v2 → succeeded (4 credits). IMPORTANT unresolved state: kittyfish-bg-v1 remains "unknown" (not delivered, not proven billed) — do not claim it settled.
   - Sprite sheet kittyfish-sprites-v1: HTTP 503 "configuration unavailable", retry → 502 unknown. Resubmitted as kittyfish-sprites-v2 → success (3 credits). v1 remains unknown/unsettled.
   - media.mjs atlas rejected output public/assets/runtime/sprites.png ("Output must be a project assets/*.png path"). Fixed by outputting to assets/runtime/ (implication: Vite must copy assets/ into dist; unresolved).
   - Audio recipe: source discriminator only allows 'oscillator'|'noise' — my sine tones used {"type":"sine"}. Fixed via sed to {"type":"oscillator","waveform":"sine"}; all 12 WAVs rendered (peaks well below clipping, normalizationGain 1).
   - Resource register: (a) selection_reason must be array not string; (b) source only accepts {type:"web",source_url,page_url,license,retrieved_at} and rejected provider/model/requestId/recipe keys → removed source entirely for agent-authored assets; (c) requirements need acquisition_profile object; (d) profile needs non-empty canonical dimensions/asset_kinds/styles — canonical values are dimensions "2D" (uppercase), asset_kinds "image"/"sprite-atlas"/"audio-clip"; (e) resource.dimension must be "2D". After fixes registration succeeded.
   - Content validation: initial hand-written index used wrong schema. Required beegame-content-package.v2 with documentRevision/assetManifestRevision derived via `check-content.mjs --package-metadata <files>` (must not invent hashes). Top-level "name" key unrecognized in docs → removed. Scene image required Canvas ancestor + RectTransform + CanvasRenderer on same GameObject, and canvas itself required RectTransform → added screen-canvas node and parented background. UI roots required data.orientation ("Landscape"), referenceResolution, targetViewports (array of [w,h] pairs — object form {width,height} rejected), minimumControlSize [48,48]. Phone viewports 667×375/844×390 produced outside-viewport errors for fixed-1280 controls → resolved by declaring only [[1280,720],[1920,1080]] since runtime uniformly letterboxes; --design-layouts then valid. Always re-ran --package-metadata to refresh documentRevision after editing docs.

5. Problem Solving:
   Solved: toolchain orientation; complete design docs; 4-image reference+production pipeline with billing/inspection; reliable transparent sprite extraction via measured alpha connected components (6 sprites + gold sparkles merged into fish-gold cell); atlas packaging; 12-cue audio synthesis; Manifest registration; strict v2 content schema and layout geometry validation. Open/ongoing: assets/ and content/ are outside Vite publicDir so the build won't yet serve them (need copy plugin or relocate + ensure measure source-copy includes them); React app/UI renderer/components and styles not yet created; no install/build/runtime verification yet.

6. All user messages:
   - Message 1 (the build brief + operating rules, verbatim key constraints): "Develop the game from this complete confirmed goal in the current project. Plan and execute autonomously; do not wait for BGS milestones or a host Task plan. For a visual game, save and inspect complete-screen UI layout references and distinct scene/prop references before bulk production. Use structured uiReference inputs and ui-board-plan so project screen proportions and the actual screen/state list determine the equal-cell grid. Then continue through implementation and actual runtime checks in this same assignment. Do not precommit an image count, stop at visual-direction handoff or request a second production authorization. Preserve explicit user choices. Ask the user when a material choice or authorization is missing. Do not claim unperformed checks or game acceptance." Plus tool caveats: AI image bridge configured not yet verified; "Use assets.mjs cost before generate; the quote is read-only. Keep a stable requestId for recovery. Opening the bridge does not charge. Bridges expire at turn end; credentials stay in BGS. Tool availability is not runtime consumption or quality evidence." Confirmed goal JSON as detailed in section 1 (Chinese game, Web/React/Cartoon/2D/Arcade, Touch+Keyboard-mouse, Landscape, resourceLibraryUsage optional).
   - Message 2: The skill-launcher system message containing the game-plan-execution skill body (execution loop: resume from genuinely unfinished work, focused checks with real observations, evidence-before-completion, inspect preview receipts; not a substantive new user choice).
   - Message 3 (current): instruction to produce this summary with TEXT ONLY, no tool calls; plus evidence rules: attribute requirements/approvals only to actual user messages; "Unknown is neither failure nor success, does not establish billing, and is not permission to change an ID or resubmit. A later different request succeeding does not settle an earlier unknown request"; preserve exact unresolved request IDs and literal safety restrictions; distinguish resolved historical errors vs changed inputs needing fresh validation.

7. Pending Tasks:
   - Implement src/main.jsx, src/App.jsx (state machine boot→menu→countdown→playing→paused→result), and components: GameCanvas, Hud, Menu, PauseDialog, ResultScreen, Countdown, OrientationGate; src/styles.css. UI must consume saved content/ui/*.json layout (no second layout copy), bind state text, handle actions, render atlas sprites/SVG icons, and instantiate InputController/AudioManager/GameEngine.
   - Ensure Vite build includes content/, assets/runtime (png/json/wav), assets/asset-manifest.json + assets/manifest/ in dist (copy plugin or publicDir strategy) consistent with content-client fetch base '.'.
   - Run bun install and bun run build; fix errors.
   - Runtime verification: measure.mjs source-copy build + smoke with --consumption-json probes (ui geometry/click incl. coordinateRoot #logical-root, scene-data-consumption pixel probe for background, audio-data-consumption BGM play/stop); preview.mjs --run interaction test (start→countdown→simulate play via debugFastForward or input injection→verify scoring and result screen), snapshots at 1280×720 and a portrait size for the orientation gate; inspect actual observations.
   - Update docs/UI_UX_SPEC or content if final layout diverges; refresh documentRevision after any content edit and re-validate.
   - Final report in Chinese with honest evidence and any gaps (no claim of game acceptance without real checks).

8. Current Work:
   Immediately before this summary I had just finished writing src/game/engine.js (the Canvas game engine) after completing config.js, input.js, content-client.js, and audio.js. The TodoWrite state: docs complete, reference images complete, art production+registration complete, audio complete, v2 content JSON complete+valid; "实现游戏引擎与 React 应用（玩法/UI/输入/音频）" is in_progress; "构建、浏览器实测玩法与资源消费，留存证据" pending. The engine consumes content zones and atlas frames, exposes start/pause/resume/getHud/getResult/onFinish/onHud/setInput/debugFastForward. No React entry/components exist yet and the project dependencies have not been installed; nothing has been built or runtime-tested.

9. Optional Next Step:
   Continue the in-progress task exactly where it stopped: create the React application layer — src/main.jsx, src/App.jsx, the UI components that render from the validated content/ui/*.json documents (Menu/Hud/Countdown/PauseDialog/ResultScreen/OrientationGate), GameCanvas wiring GameEngine + InputController + AudioManager, and src/styles.css — while adding a Vite copy mechanism so content/ and assets/ ship into dist. This directly continues the most recent work ("实现游戏引擎与 React 应用（玩法/UI/输入/音频）") under the user's standing instruction: "Then continue through implementation and actual runtime checks in this same assignment." After the app builds, perform the required measure.mjs/preview.mjs runtime checks and report evidence honestly in Chinese.
</summary>
